_about: Third-party and own skills tracked by desk-skills. Types: `github` and `drive` entries keep the exact upstream files in vendor/<name>/ at `pin`; `checkout` entries are git clones in ~/.agents/skills/<name> (or ~/.agents/sources/<name> with `subskills` linked in) and have no vendor/ copy. install.sh installs each as the ONE real copy in ~/.agents/skills/<name> and links ~/.claude/skills/<name> to it. `bin/skills-upstream outdated` compares each pin with its source and only reports; `bin/skills-upstream upgrade <name>` pulls the newest upstream into vendor/ for review as a git diff (or `git pull --ff-only` for a checkout). `tree_sha256` is the hash of the vendored folder (sorted relative paths and file contents), checked by `skills-upstream verify` and re-recorded by `skills-upstream rehash`. `tools` are not skills: each is a whole GitHub repo pinned to a commit, installed by the repo's own `installer` run from a copy of the repo at the pin (`skills-upstream statusline install`), with no vendor/ copy; `outdated` reports them and `upgrade <name>` moves the pin.
